name: Aelnir Video Compressor
seoTitle: Aelnir Video Compressor: shrink video files offline on Android
summary: Shrink videos on your phone, trim them and convert them. Nothing is uploaded.
tagline: Make videos small enough to send, without a server. Pick a preset or a target size, then save a verified copy.

features.title: Smaller videos, on your phone
features.lead: Processing runs on your device and works offline.

items.title: Presets or a target size
items.body: Choose a preset, or aim for a file size and let the app plan the resolution, frame rate, bitrate and audio.

items.title: Trim first
items.body: Cut the start and end on a timeline with thumbnails before you compress.

items.title: Preview before you commit
items.body: Check the result in a player before it is saved.

items.title: Verified output
items.body: Each export is checked, retried or switched to another codec if it fails, then saved to Movies/Aelnir.

items.title: Background export
items.body: Long jobs keep running in a foreground service, with a notification for progress.

items.title: Share in
items.body: Send a video to the app from any other app, and find past jobs in History.

strip.label: Does
strip.text: Compress · Trim · Convert · Target size · Preview · History

note.label: Free, with ads
note.title: Your videos never leave your phone
note.body: Aelnir Video Compressor is free and supported by ads. Every video is processed on your device. There is no server to upload to.

studioProof.hard: A planner that picks resolution, frame rate, bitrate and audio to hit a target size, with retry and codec fallback.
